title: Fable rank 80 (on-death half)
problem: Same cause: the on-death repeat never happens (also starves rank 90).
notes: Fix: H: call with "allow dead" Hook batch R (loader/hooks_R.c, research/hooks_R.json). In-game test: Fable at rank 80 on a creature with an on-death effect: when it dies, the on-death effect activates twice (rank 90's stat growth counts both).

release_notes.intended: Your creatures' on-death effects activate 1 additional time.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the extra activation never happened.
release_notes.fix: Now on-death effects activate the additional time, and the deaths are counted for the relic's rank-90 bonus as well.
